laws.subject: Murder
laws.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
laws.key_changes: Section number changed from 302 to 103. The substantive provisions remain largely similar.

laws.subject: Rape
laws.description: Defines the offence of rape and its punishment, including imprisonment which shall not be less than ten years and may extend to imprisonment for life.
laws.key_changes: Section number changed from 376 to 65. Community service introduced as a punishment for certain offences.

laws.subject: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
laws.description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property.
laws.key_changes: Section number changed from 420 to 318. Provisions remain substantively similar.

laws.subject: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
laws.description: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished.
laws.key_changes: Section number changed from 498A to 86. Substantive provisions remain similar with enhanced focus on women's safety.

laws.subject: Dowry death
laws.description: Where the death of a woman is caused by burns or bodily injury within seven years of marriage and it is shown that she was subjected to cruelty by husband or relatives in connection with demand for dowry.
laws.key_changes: Section number changed from 304B to 80. The provision remains substantively the same.

laws.subject: First Information Report (FIR)
laws.description: Information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence given to the police, recorded as FIR.
laws.key_changes: FIR can now also be filed electronically. Zero FIR concept formalized allowing filing at any police station regardless of jurisdiction.

laws.subject: Arrest without warrant
laws.description: Specifies when a police officer may arrest without a warrant.
laws.key_changes: Mandatory requirement to display arrest memo. Use of handcuffs restricted to specific categories of offences.

laws.subject: Admissibility of electronic records
laws.description: Electronic records are admissible as evidence, subject to conditions laid down.
laws.key_changes: Expanded scope of electronic evidence. Includes emails, server logs, digital documents, GPS data, and messages from communication devices.

laws.subject: Theft
laws.description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
laws.key_changes: Section number changed from 379 to 305. Community service added as possible punishment for petty theft.

laws.subject: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention
laws.description: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all, each of such persons is liable for that act.
laws.key_changes: Now covered under Section 3(5) of BNS. The principle of common intention remains the same.
